title: Tune Ridge and Lasso pipelines
description: You select regularization settings by cross-validation and compare test metrics.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You place scaling and Ridge regression in one pipeline. The grid compares alpha values and intercept choices with five-fold R-squared scoring.
You fit the Ridge search on training rows and evaluate its selected model on test rows. The recording selects alpha=10 with an intercept and reports test R-squared.
You build a second scaled pipeline for Lasso and its own alpha grid. It uses the same fold count and scoring metric.

steps.question: Does Lasso's slightly higher recorded cross-validation score also give it a higher recorded test R-squared?
steps.answer: Lasso's recorded cross-validation score is slightly higher than Ridge's. Its recorded test R-squared is slightly lower.

steps.description: You print the selected Lasso settings and test errors. The recording selects alpha=1 with an intercept and reports test mean squared error.
